notes: The game now asks which language you use the first time you start it (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文); change it any time in Settings
Title menu no longer shows a scrollbar; sign-in screens tidied
Free accounts: sign up with email, username and password; friends, co-op invites and cloud saves
Without an account you get a 2-chapter demo; multiplayer needs an account
Continue resumes at the exact line and spot you quit from
NPCs can be hit; weapon panel hides when you have no weapon or are in dialogue
New version alerts with this change log
